name: Slayer Toolkit
description: For people who grind hard levels: a death graph by percent, notes tied to percents that pop up before the spot, progress stats, session stats, break reminder, retry delay, stream mode, silent mode, level history and profiles. Opens from the pause menu.

show-hints.name: Show note hints
show-hints.description: Show your note a few percent before the spot it belongs to.

break-reminder.name: Break reminder
break-reminder.description: Remind you to rest after a while of playing.

session-goal.name: Session goal
session-goal.description: Percent you want to reach today. You get a message when you reach it. 0 turns it off.

tilt-warning.name: Early death warning
tilt-warning.description: Suggest a break after 5 deaths below 10% in a row.

heat-bar.name: Death strip
heat-bar.description: Show a thin strip at the top of the screen, red where you die most. Off by default.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: A preset for retry delay, hints and breaks. Custom uses your own values below.

retry-delay.name: Retry delay
retry-delay.description: Seconds to wait before the level restarts after a death. 0 keeps the normal behaviour.

stream-mode.name: Stream mode
stream-mode.description: Hide the attempt counter and show only a session timer.

silent-mode.name: Silent mode
silent-mode.description: Turn the level music off, sound effects stay on.
